newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Grafton shares up 20p on bullish sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Grafton shares up 20p on bullish sentiment.

text.p: Grafton Group Plc's share price rose 20 pence to 740 on Tuesday on the back of bullish sentiment towards the construction sector in Ireland, dealers said.
"A jump of 20 pence in this kind of share is not unique. The company has benefitted from bullishness in the sector," one dealer said.
"Grafton had not traded in a while, so it is playing catch-up," the dealer added.
Analysts expect Irish-based building materials group Grafton to report robust profits for the year when it releases full-year results in the next few weeks.
